# angle_between_vectors

Nguồn: [manim.utils.space_ops.angle_between_vectors](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.utils.space_ops.html#manim.utils.space_ops.angle_between_vectors)

angle\_between\_vectors(*v1*, *v2*)
:   Returns the angle between two vectors.
    This angle will always be between 0 and pi

    Parameters:
    :   - **v1** (*ndarray*) – The first vector.
        - **v2** (*ndarray*) – The second vector.

    Returns:
    :   The angle between the vectors.

    Return type:
